# `schema_of_json`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns schema in the DDL format of JSON string.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
schema_of_json(json[, options])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `json_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- schema_of_json, example 1
> SELECT schema_of_json('[{"col":0}]');
ARRAY<STRUCT<col: BIGINT>>
```

```sql
-- schema_of_json, example 2
> SELECT schema_of_json('[{"col":01}]', map('allowNumericLeadingZeros', 'true'));
ARRAY<STRUCT<col: BIGINT>>
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
